nl: 用 antd 风格做员工档案管理：查询有员工姓名；表格展示员工姓名、所属部门、工龄、新人引导；支持新增、编辑、删除。表单里「新人引导」在工龄满 5 年时隐藏（老员工无需新人引导）。
nlEn: Employee-profile management with an Ant Design look: query by employee name; the table shows employee name, department, years of service and onboarding task; supports add, edit and delete. In the form, the "onboarding task" is hidden when the years of service reach 5 (veterans need no onboarding).
notes: AI-16: 表达式 isHidden（序关系 >=）—— 工龄满 5 年时隐藏新人引导（antdv/SFC）
